pattern.short_summary: The system takes the interrogative turn: it poses questions — clarification prompts, structured fields, interview turns — and the user's answers, rather than a user-composed prompt, constitute the specification the system works from.
pattern.definition: The system takes the interrogative turn: it poses questions — clarification prompts, structured fields, interview turns — and the user's answers, rather than a user-composed prompt, constitute the specification the system works from. The usual prompt-then-generate direction is inverted.
pattern.structural_signature: A system-authored question precedes any user content at the head of the loop, and each reply is written into the input record consumed by the next stage. The set of questions determines which slots of the specification exist, so the user never composes a full specification unprompted.

dimension.category_description: How users, artifacts, examples, parameters, or user-state signals specify intent and shape the system's next behavior.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a user-facing specification or adaptive interaction; invisible sensing infrastructure is excluded.
